text:
sara_fin: FYI vendor (Manila Analytics) uploaded an invoice for our reseller rebate but they've withheld 2% local tax and are asking us to gross-up per their PO. Invoice attached in bill.com.
leo_sales: Link to invoice: https://app.bill.com/inv/PH-98321

sara_fin: Uploaded to our Bills queue and flagged as 'tax dispute'. Contract reference: section 7.2 mentions gross-up for local taxes but i'm not 100% sure how we treat this operationally. do we honor and reimburse the withholding?

natalie_legal: Can you paste the exact clause? Also do we have any earlier precedent with PH partners?

sara_fin: Clause: "If Partner is required by law to withhold any taxes on amounts payable under this Agreement, Customer shall increase the amounts payable so that, after deduction of such withholding taxes, Partner receives the full amount it would have received had no withholding been required."

natalie_legal: That reads like a contractual gross-up. Need to confirm vendor is a taxable PH entity (TIN) and whether the 2% is a final withholding. If it's final, we still gross-up but will need documentation for tax filings.

tax-bot: Automated check: vendor country=PH, vendor type=domestic service provider, typical withholding for commissions/fees=2% (final for certain categories). Please collect vendor TIN and BIR Form 2307/2306 to support credit.

miguel_ar: From AP/GL perspective we treat this as a gross-up payment. Example: invoice amount = 1000 PHP, vendor withheld 20 PHP. We will pay vendor 1000 PHP (gross) and set up a payable for WHT remittance. JE sketch: `Dr Partner Rebates 1000; Cr Cash 1000` then after remitting WHT: `Dr WHT Payable 20; Cr Cash 20` and record reimbursement if we pay vendor additional 20 to net them up. If vendor already retained 20, we issue top-up 20 to vendor and remit 20 to BIR.

leo_sales: So vendor expects net 980 but contract says pay 1000 + reimburse 20. They want the reimbursement as a separate line on the bill?

sara_fin: i've asked vendor to confirm their TIN and upload BIR supporting docs. Also asked if they can reissue invoice showing the gross-up line.

natalie_legal: Approve proceeding to gross-up subject to receiving TIN and a signed statement that the 2% is required by PH law. We'll need to keep Form 2307 proof for our tax credit.

miguel_ar: Approved from accounting. Please route invoice to 'Partner Rebates' cost center and tag as 'grossed-up'. I'll prepare the JE and remittance schedule once vendor docs are in.

sara_fin: Will follow up with vendor and update bill.com. If they won't provide 2307, we should not reimburse until Legal confirms alternative evidence.

leo_sales: Noted — i'll ping them for expedited docs.

sara_fin: thanks all :thumbsup:

system_bot: Invoice PH-98321 uploaded by manila-ops at 2024-11-17 09:12 UTC.
